title: Irreducibility of random 0–1 polynomials (Odlyzko–Poonen)
live_statement: Let P_d(x) = x^d + A_{d−1}x^{d−1} + ⋯ + A_1 x + 1, where A_1, …, A_{d−1} are independent and uniform on {0, 1}. Odlyzko and Poonen conjectured that P(P_d is irreducible in Z[x]) → 1 as d → ∞.

paper.title: The Odlyzko-Poonen Conjecture on Irreducibility of Random Polynomials

source.theorem_quote:
Theorem 1.1. As n →∞,
P(Pn is irreducible over Q) −→1.

scope_match: Same monic, constant coefficient 1, independent uniform remaining coefficients in {0,1}, and degree tending to infinity. The target is irreducibility, not the stronger full-Galois-group variant.
